text:
The chat-model proposal is clear, so I rewrote nothing. `node Server/text-check.mjs` flagged nothing on the task directory. The brief is for agents, and its eight steps are a numbered list with no long paragraphs. I logged one "clear" line to `flags.jsonl`.

I didn't screenshot a page because the proposal has no `page.js`.

The verdict is **fix**: three things need changing, plus four smaller observations. The review covers step 1 only (the phase-0 fixes), because that is all the diff contains. I wrote it to `chat-model/review.md`. This diff changes no page, so the review has only the Requirements and Words sections and no screenshots.

**Must change:**
1. **Fix 2 now makes duplicate lines in one case.** A tab's post now carries its own id (`client`), but the copy it appends as a fallback when the post is slow does not. So when the post finally lands after the fallback has already written the line, the duplicate check misses it and the line is written twice. `doc/one-writer.md:231` says this can't happen. The existing test for this order (`one-writer.test.mjs:103`) still passes only because it posts without a `client`, which no real tab does any more.
2. **Fix 1 is marked "Done" but covers one write path out of three.** The newline guard is only in `RecordWriter.append_once`. The two paths most writes go through still append without it: `write_line` in `page_tools.js` (Servex's entry point) and the dev server's `Append.js`.
3. **Fix 5 changes how a new list item is saved, and some readers weren't checked.** Its fields are now saved under `data` instead of at the top level. `rail.js:484`, `Activity.js:143` and `SessionTimelineRows.js:97` read those fields from the top level, so a card added from the browser would show up blank in those summaries.

**Worth a look:**
- `SessionConsolidate.mjs` still rewrites files the unsafe way; the new safe-write helper is used by only one caller.
- The temporary file the helper writes during each save sends a live-reload notice to every tab. Probably harmless, but not checked.
- Fix 3 has no test, and status.md doesn't link to the code that proves it.
- Steps 2–8 aren't built yet, and child task `s1` is still open.

**Tests:** everything that exists passes. The test runner gives 22 of 22 over `core/Item` and `core/List`, and the five new or changed test files pass when run directly.

Logged. Three-line report:

**What changed:** All 5 Phase 0 fixes (data-shapes/design/fixes.md) landed, plus review round 1's 3 fixes (client id missing from the fallback line, newline guard extended to the other two append paths, three readers of a flat `add` line now read `data` first) and 3 smaller items (SessionConsolidate → Runtime.safe_write, watch.js ignores `.tmp-`, status.md's Phase 0 cell split into a scannable list).

**Tests:** core/Item + core/List + core/Session 25/25 (was 22/22 baseline); `one-writer.test.mjs` 24→30 checks; `page_tools.test.mjs` and `Append.test.mjs` unchanged (33, 12). Every new case confirmed to fail against the pre-fix code.

**Commits:** `79a690bab` (Phase 0 fixes 2/4/5), `f5b3240fc` (review round 1). s1 left open for the mastermind per instruction.

Already produced results this turn: commits `79a690bab` and `f5b3240fc` (Phase 0 fixes 2/4/5, then review round 1's fixes), plus a log line in `builder/session.jsonl` summarizing both. Per my brief, I end each step there and wait for the mastermind to merge and send the next step — s1 is intentionally left open for them, so no further action from me right now.

Step 1 (Phase 0 fixes) is done and committed — `79a690bab` then `f5b3240fc` after the mastermind's review round 1 — with a summary logged in `builder/session.jsonl`. Per my brief, I stop here and wait for the mastermind (`mastermind-chat-model`) to merge and hand me step 2; not starting new work in the meantime.

Views plan step 3 needs two additive fields on the Prompt MESSAGE in session.messages: `sent` ({fast, smart}: the ✓ and 🧠 marks, today on the Prompt task) and `working` (with its `at`, for V2's 🧠 dots). ChatV2 (now extends ChatV3, bc5e17255) reads them through the message's `prompt` link to its task and a small {chat}/{sent} tracker (ChatV2.js prompt_of, sent_by_task) until then. Could you add them in your next step, or say which step they fit? Once they exist I brief a Sonnet minion to read them directly and delete the tracker (ext/Chat/v2/ only). Plan: /framework/core/Session/Chat/doc/views-on-messages.md, 'No field, needs one (step 3)'.

**What changed:** Found and fixed the real root cause of `Task.steps.test.mjs`'s replay failure — `List.add()`'s announce was nesting `data` and child lists by live reference, not a snapshot, so a member mutated after being added (before its queued line ever flushed) silently rewrote its own `add` line. Switched to `JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(...))` (structuredClone fails on `Item.parent`). Added a regression test using `ScratchStore` (matches `Task.steps.test.mjs`'s own harness, unlike a synchronous append override which hides the bug). Grepped `ext/`+`ai/` for other add-line replayers: 4 found, all read node/Servex-constructed lines unaffected by this fix — no further changes needed.

**Tests:** Every `core/*.test.mjs` (`TestRunner.mjs public/framework/core`): 42/42, including `Task.steps.test.mjs`. `one-writer.test.mjs`: 30/30 unchanged.

**Commit:** `10b1c466b`. Logged to `builder/session.jsonl`; s1 left open for the mastermind.

I wrote the review to `chat-model/review.md` with verdict: fix. The diff covers step 2 only (F7, Ref as a chat member, resurface). I read the diff and the docs but did not run the tests.

- **Census missing:** the brief asked for a census of callers that `add` an already-owned item, but there is no census anywhere in the task folder. F7 is now live, so any such caller silently gets a Ref instead of the item.
- **Callers untested:** the new tests prove `add()` makes a Ref, but nothing shows the existing callers still work.
- **Resurface not atomic:** `Chat.resurface` adds the Ref and then marks the original in two separate lines. A crash between them leaves a Ref with no mark.
- **Doc gap:** the `resurfaced` mark is not in `views-on-messages.md`, which dictation-v3 relies on.

I also filed five notes: a detached-list edge case in `foreign_ref`, `add()` now returning the Ref, the test's "15 checks" count, a missing step-2 summary in `s2/`, and that the requirements for this step are otherwise met.

Committed. Per the mastermind's instruction, I will not re-run `review.mjs`.

**3-line report:** List.add()'s own default is reverted to michael/dev's re-parenting behavior; added explicit `list.ref(x)` (same-file `{path}` / cross-file `{url, path}`), used by `Chat.resurface`. Census of every `List.add`/`.adopt()`/`Item.adopt_slot` caller in `public/framework` and `Servex` found none relying on the move side-effect, recorded in `plan.md` decision 2; review findings n1–n9 answered in `s2/session.jsonl`. Commit `9221769ba`; TestRunner over `public/framework/core` 42/42, `Servex/agents/chat-messages.test.mjs` 13/13.
